```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, error=FALSE, comment='', dpi=400)
library(dplyr)
library(flextable)

TeachingDemos::char2seed('southampton')
n_sample = 20
```

We randomly selected a subsample of the processed data to manually verify the data entry and processing.

## Data from Research Assistant

```{r ra}
# data from 5_read_pdf_comments_by_RA.R
load('data/5_audit.RData')
# sample and table
sample = filter(long, question != 'interpretation') %>% # interpretation is not processed, so do not use
  sample_n(n_sample) %>%
  select(doi, question, response)
ftab = flextable(sample) %>%
  theme_box() %>% 
  autofit()
ftab
```

## Data from automation

```{r automation}
# data from 5_read_pdf_files_to_xml_automate.R
load('data/5_automated.RData')
# sample and table
sample = sample_n(auto_data, n_sample) %>%
  select(doi, protocol, analysis_plan, ethics, equator, conflict, funding, registration)
ftab = flextable(sample) %>%
  theme_box() %>% 
  autofit()
ftab
```

## Data from OpenAlex

```{r openalex}
# data from 5_open_alex.R
load('data/5_open_alex.RData')
# sample and table
sample = sample_n(open_alex_data, n_sample) %>%
  select(doi, n_total, n_ais, first_author, last_author, cited)
ftab = flextable(sample) %>%
  theme_box() %>% 
  autofit()
ftab
```
